headline: Tarn Taran Stubble Fire Activity and Amritsar Air Quality Daily Briefing
briefing: On 2025-10-31, Tarn Taran recorded 49 fire detections with a total fire radiative power of 226.1 MW, ranking 2 in Punjab, where the total count was 273. The district 7-day mean fire count is 24.6, representing a 99.4% change versus this 7-day mean. In the 2024 season, satellite monitoring recorded 676 fire detections in Tarn Taran [K111]. Satellite fire detections are a lower bound due to cloud cover, missed fires, and overpass timing [K111]. At nearest monitored city Amritsar, today's PM2.5 level was 99.3 ug/m3. The next-day forecast predicts a p50 of 102.2 ug/m3, with an 80% uncertainty band spanning from a p10 of 67.1 ug/m3 to a p90 of 133.7 ug/m3. Wind at Amritsar blows from the NW at 5.0 km/h. As context, upwind fire radiative power is 662.9 MW, with Outside Punjab contributing 96.1% and Tarn Taran contributing 0.1%.
